model: Dynasonics TFX Ultra transit-time flow / energy meter (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Dynasonics TFX Ultra clamp-on flow and energy transmitters ordered with the BACnet MS/TP RS-485 option.
summary: The TFX Ultra is a clamp-on transit-time ultrasonic flow meter; energy models add two temperature inputs. On BACnet MS/TP it serves 11 analog inputs (signal strength, rate, three totalizers, both temperatures in °C and °F, flow in GPM and LPM) and a binary output that resets the totalizers.
notes: The table gives a description and object ID only, with no Object_Name column; the description is used as the name here.
AI 2 carries flow rate on flow models and energy rate on energy (BTU) models, in the units chosen in the meter. The MS/TP map has no unit-code objects.
Instances are not contiguous (AI 1-7, 11, 12, 16, 17); they match the BACnet IP map numbering.
Access is not printed per object; inputs are shown read-only and BO 1 writable as the notes describe.
Source: Table 18 'BACnet MSTP object mappings', page 76 (12 objects).

source.title: TFX Ultra Flow and Energy Meters User Manual

integration.summary: Set the meter address (MS/TP MAC), baud rate and BACnet device ID from the keypad or UltraLink, then read the rate, the totalizers and (energy models) the temperatures.

minimum_points.name: Flow Rate (Flow model) / Energy Rate (BTU model)
minimum_points.why: Flow rate (flow models) or energy rate (BTU models)

minimum_points.name: Signal Strength
minimum_points.why: Signal strength; low means poor coupling

setup: ADDRESS (0-127) is the MS/TP MAC, BAUD the RS-485 rate, BACNET ID the device instance (0-4194303); set them in the BSC menu or with UltraLink.
The PICS lists MS/TP master at 9600, 19200, 38400 and 76800 baud.
Save the changes when leaving the menu; settings are kept in flash memory.
gotchas: BO 1 returns to inactive by itself after the reset.
